1. The present accident claim is based on a detailed accident
report (Dar) filed by the police in terms of provisions of Motor
Vehicle Act, in which one Prem Pal Singh (aged 70 years)
suffered fatal injuries.

2.  The brief facts of the case are that on 12.01.2020, upon receipt of information by the police vide DD no.15A regarding occurrence of an accident, SI Kanhaiya Lal alongwith Ct Lokesh reached the spot.
On the spot, a vehicle/Champion bearing no.DL-1LU-8876 was found in accidental condition with its driver namely Ashok Kumar.

ASI Bhanendra informed that while he was on patrolling duty and was coming towards Sukhdev Vihar, at about 3.05 PM, he saw a Champion(cargo carriage vehicle) No.DL-1LU-8876 (hereinafter referred to as offending vehicle) hit a pedestrian.
Due to the impact, the pedestrian was dragged to about 40 feet.
ASI Bhanendra apprehended the driver of the offending vehicle and sent the injured to the hospital.
During treatment, injured Prem Pal Singh died.
His postmortem was conducted.
3. An FIR no.009/2020 dated 12.01.2020 was registered u/s 279,304 A IPC at PS New Friends Colony and the matter was investigated.
After investigation, charge sheet was filed before concerned criminal court against the driver of the offending vehicle while DAR was filed before this Tribunal.
